City council approves new bike lanes

By Lois Lane, March 4, 2025

The city council voted 7–2 on Tuesday to fund 40 km of protected bike lanes, the largest expansion in the city’s history. The plan, first proposed by Councillor Perry White, will cost an estimated $12 million over three years.

“This is about safety,” said White. “Every protected lane we’ve built has cut injuries by more than half.”

What happens next

Construction on the first 8 km, along Main Street and River Road, begins in May. The remaining segments will be built in phases through 2027.

Opponents argued the money would be better spent on road repairs. Councillor Jimmy Olsen, who voted against, said the city had “a pothole problem, not a bike problem.”
